## [1.0.0-dev.18](https://github.com/yak9909/FilesPlus/compare/v1.0.0-dev.17...v1.0.0-dev.18) (2026-11-12)

### ✨ New Features

* Add FilesLook (reuse the app's layouts by name) and a UI sample in diagnostics ([1c5f14d](https://github.com/yak9909/FilesPlus/commit/1c5f14d9e13476a0ad96833b2fa5e2aba2e2bf32))
* Add the browse core (Location, BrowseSource, LocalSource, ThumbLoader) ([a8a168e](https://github.com/yak9909/FilesPlus/commit/a8a168e9a09234835faee6c75c13073d594f2bf8))
* Add the destination browser (BrowseActivity, pick mode) with a diagnostics test entry ([2801de1](https://github.com/yak9909/FilesPlus/commit/2801de174bf13a9f9f625cf290ee00021deba850))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Republish the pre-release after the failed dev.18 release run ([9b0ec9c](https://github.com/yak9909/FilesPlus/commit/9b0ec9caf23ab72b4502fa2353bf7c6d0071faf9))

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Install Files alongside the system app with a different package name and label.

options.description: A unique Android package name for the patched app.
The application and launcher name in every language.

patches.name: Custom skip duration
patches.description: Customize double-tap and button skip durations; long-press a skip button to change its duration. Optionally, a double-tap rewind near the start goes to the start.

patches.name: Delete folder from tabs
patches.description: Move the current folder to the FilesPlus trash (kept 30 days) from category tabs, with confirmation and protected folders.

patches.name: High-resolution playback
patches.description: Try videos beyond reported decoder limits, enable decoder fallback, and log playback diagnostics.

patches.name: Move queue in preview
patches.description: Add Send to… to the preview screen's menu to move the current file (or the selected files) to a folder in the background. Single files that are not playing move on to the next file at once; playing videos and multi-file sends are moved without changing the page.

patches.name: Move to current tab
patches.description: Add a selection-mode menu item that moves the selected files into the folder of the current category tab.

patches.name: Multi-select in preview
patches.description: Add Select / Deselect items to the preview screen's menu to collect files while previewing, and select them in the list when you go back.

patches.name: Show empty folder tabs
patches.description: Remember category folders and optionally append tabs for known folders with no matching files.
